audit.why: Ziggs taking levels 1-5 and the last three stages reading 'Skill' fits a 45% Sejuani win rate over 60 games — the worst matchup in this slice. The kits support it: Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 over 850 units and Hexplosive Minefield is 16s flat over 900, against Arctic Assault's 18s and 650. He resets his poke roughly three times per gap-close attempt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Inferno Bomb is never mentioned anywhere in either layer. The mid paragraph attributes Ziggs's level 6 spike to Short Fuse instead.
audit.why: Short Fuse is a passive that exists from level 1 — it is not what changes at 6. Mega Inferno Bomb is: 120/95/70 seconds over a 5000-unit range, which means from level 6 onward he threatens the objective fights this entry says Sejuani should be starting, from outside any range she can contest. Naming the wrong ability as his power spike means the player never learns to check that cooldown before committing R at dragon.
audit.corrected: Mega Inferno Bomb: 120/95/70s over 5000 units — that is his level 6, not Short Fuse, and it reaches every objective fight you start.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json (Mega Inferno Bomb cd 120/95/70, range 5000; Short Fuse is the passive)

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers claim Satchel Charge can displace Sejuani's ultimate: 'Satchel Charge (W) can knock your comet away if he times it' and 'he can knock the comet with Satchel Charge if he reacts'. Riot's text for Satchel Charge describes it knocking away enemies and Ziggs himself. Nothing in it interacts with a projectile in flight.
audit.why: The advice that follows from the false version is wrong in a specific, costly way — 'throw it at his feet, not at his body' is offered as a way to beat a projectile-swat that does not exist. The real interaction is better and points the other direction: Satchel Charge knocks Ziggs himself away, so he dodges Glacial Prison by self-displacing out of its path. That means you lead where the blast will throw him rather than aiming where he currently stands, which is the opposite adjustment.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge does not knock your bola aside — it knocks Ziggs. He dodges by self-displacing, so aim where the blast will put him, not at his feet.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json (Satchel Charge: 'The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage' — no projectile interaction in the description)

audit.whatIsWrong: Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, and Hexplosive Minefield is Ziggs's only slow. Neither layer mentions it, and the entry repeatedly gives the mine slow as the reason Sejuani cannot approach.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the entry states the opposite of it. Out of combat Frost Armor is up, so the mines do not slow her at all — the first approach of any given sequence is free, and it stops being free only once his Bouncing Bomb chip has stripped the buff. That reframes the entire lane from 'you have no way to close' to 'you have exactly one way to close, and his poke is what takes it away'. It also explains why the correct play is to hold at max range until the buff is back rather than trading chip for chip.
audit.corrected: Frost Armor makes you immune to slows out of combat, so Hexplosive Minefield does not slow your first approach — his Bouncing Bomb chip is what removes that immunity, not the mines.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Fury of the North: 'immunity to slows'; 'persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage')
champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json (slow flag on Hexplosive Minefield only)

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says his poke 'chips your Permafrost off', 'strips your Permafrost armor' and keeps 'your passive armor bonus offline' in four places. Permafrost is Sejuani's E stun and has no armour component or passive.
audit.why: In this matchup the misnaming actively hides the mechanic that matters most. The thing his poke strips is Frost Armor, which is also what carries the slow immunity — so the player never connects 'he chipped me' to 'and now his mines slow me'. Naming it correctly turns four scattered complaints into one causal chain the player can act on.
audit.corrected: The buff his poke removes is Frost Armor from Fury of the North, which carries both the resistances and the slow immunity — that is why chip damage costs you the approach.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Fury of the North and Permafrost descriptions)

edits.before: Level 6 is the first time you're a real threat, but Ziggs is also stronger at 6 because Short Fuse (passive) empowers his autos and his wave-clear becomes oppressive. Your Glacial Prison (R) travels fast enough to catch him rotating or standing still — throw it at his feet when he's farming, not in a panic when he's retreating with flash up. Track his Satchel Charge obsessively: the moment it's burned on anything, that's your window to Q in. Without W to knock you back mid-dash, his only answer is to flash, and you can R the flash path. Even in this window you're not guaranteed the kill — land the R first, THEN walk up for the W-E chain, never the reverse.
edits.after: Level 6 is the first time you're a real threat, but so is Mega Inferno Bomb — 120 seconds over 5000 units, which reaches any objective fight you try to start. Your Glacial Prison travels 1300 and stuns the first champion hit; throw it while he is farming, not in a panic while he retreats with flash up. Track Satchel Charge obsessively at 20 seconds: the moment it is burned on anything, that is your window to Q in, because it is what he uses to knock himself clear of your dash. Walk in while Frost Armor still holds and his mines cannot slow you at all. Even then the kill is not guaranteed — land the R first, THEN walk up for the W-E chain, never the reverse.

notes: Best find: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows and Hexplosive Minefield is Ziggs's only slow. Both layers give the mine slow as the standing reason Sejuani cannot approach, which is the opposite of what happens — out of combat the mines do not slow her at all, and it is his Bouncing Bomb chip stripping Frost Armor that takes the approach away. That reframes the lane from 'no way to close' into 'one way to close, and his poke is what removes it', and it also ties together four scattered complaints in the entry about him 'stripping your Permafrost armor' (which is itself the wrong ability name — the buff is Frost Armor from Fury of the North; Permafrost is the E stun and has no armour component). Second: both layers claim Satchel Charge 'can knock your comet away'. Riot's description has it knocking away enemies and Ziggs himself, with no projectile interaction at all — and the true version is more useful, because he dodges Glacial Prison by self-displacing, so you lead where the blast will throw him instead of aiming at his feet as the entry currently advises. I marked that finding Medium confidence: I am confident about what Satchel Charge does from Riot's text, and 'it cannot displace a projectile' is an absence rather than a stated fact, so I wrote the correction around the positive mechanic rather than around the negative. Third: Mega Inferno Bomb appears nowhere in either layer, and the mid paragraph credits his level 6 spike to Short Fuse — a passive he has had since level 1. His actual 6 is a 120-second, 5000-unit ultimate that reaches every objective fight this entry tells Sejuani to start. The two suspectNames hits are FALSE POSITIVES; both names are written correctly.
